title: Has anyone began work on decompiling Sid Meier's Gettysburg/Antietam?
author: Pandaman_323
selftext: Just throwing a dart into the crowd and seeing if anyone has heard any rumblings about this. It's an all time Sid game that definitely could use some love for modern PC's, and with the influx of retro games getting the modernized treatment, I figure someone must be doing this or thinking about it?

comments.author: Apprehensive_Snow483
comments.body: No but I would be pumped

replies.author: Pandaman_323
replies.body: As would I - I’d love to play the single player campaign 1V1 in MP with a smoothed fps and 4k res

comments.author: the_vico
comments.body: Weird idea but I was thinking the same but for Kid Pix Deluxe 3. Would try myself but I don't have access to the good models, specially Claude (too expensive where I live)

replies.author: KeenAsGreen
replies.body:
Weird coincidence, I was just looking for a modern version of this today. 
Looking at updating it to run on win11

replies.body: Damn I used to play that all the time in elementary school lol

comments.body: Until someone fixes Dark Castle I'll never be impressed.

comments.author: LuciusPapiriusCursor
comments.body: I started a couple of weeks ago. Currently trying to remake SMG so it runs on a 3D Godot scene instead of 2d

replies.author: Pandaman_323
replies.body: Oh hell yeah! Is there Anywhere I can track progress?

replies.author: LuciusPapiriusCursor
replies.body: Give me a couple of more weeks and then I'll figure it out. I want to get at least a workable alpha that plays most of the scenarios end to end before socializing it more broadly
